purpose: One exact recorded user prompt and actual result per module. Generated SQL and image instructions are not represented as user-authored prompts.

modules.exact_prompt: this lacks visual imagery, not relevant for executive audience with low attention span, doesn't meet viral content criteria.
modules.finding: Your visual critique produced the executive reference card: diagnose the drop, find silent phones, verify routing intent, reconcile commitments, and check Supply. At onboarding, causation and recovery were still unverified.
The broad summary became a specific classification: all 147 tickets assigned once across 56 issues. Thirty report missing or reduced offers; follow-ups are not independent customers.

modules.exact_prompt: proceed with module 3 and work iteratively until completion. Use persona of native leader in this business space demonstrating rich business depth in decision making, verbiage, and deliverable (s) across all modules.
modules.finding: Farlight, Vesper, The Undertow and Meteor Mite fall from 49 combined offers per week at baseline to three in the final week, while final-week acceptance reaches 72.7%. All 160 responder-weeks were retained.

modules.exact_prompt: Proceed with Module 4 and work iteratively until completion. Keep the same business-lead perspective and validate the routing mechanism against the Module 3 findings.
modules.finding: The same controlled 75-second response succeeds with a 90-second window and misses with 60. Missed and declined both reduce history by 0.12; a listed responder can then lose future offers.

modules.exact_prompt: Proceed with Module 5 and work iteratively until completion. Keep the same business-lead perspective and use the Module 4 handoff to create the product brief and working prototype.
modules.finding: Dispatch Ready Review connects Kip, Mite and operations through explanation, readiness, five fit checks, one illustrative offer and a receipt. The prototype passes 23 browser checks; it is a proposed experience, not a deployed fix.

modules.exact_prompt: Proceed with Module 6 and work iteratively until completion. Keep the same business-lead perspective and create the reusable review skill and scheduled workflow.
modules.finding: Review-checklist ran twice against four complete briefs. It found missing ownership, missing success criteria, scope drift and solution-first framing; the second run correctly produced a quiet unchanged result.
